content.short: LP management hub for Uniswap v3 and PancakeSwap v3, with analytics, automation and vaults.
content.description: CYBRO helps liquidity providers run concentrated liquidity positions. Its dashboard tracks the performance of each position, auto-actions can close or rebalance them (currently on Arbitrum), and ready-made vaults suit people who would rather deposit and leave it. It is non-custodial and audited, works across six chains including Unichain, and has its own CYBRO token for staking and governance.
content.meta: Track, rebalance and automate Uniswap v3 and PancakeSwap LP positions, or deposit into ready-made vaults, with CYBRO.
